authority_notice.meaning: This file preserves an older production-alignment audit and no longer controls current dataset splits or acceptance gates.

contamination.evidence: the strata curator received both context and human_reply for every case
contamination.consequence: may be used for validation and process diagnosis, but not as a fresh hidden final set

production_alignment_requirements: anchor the historical window to the event timestamp
preserve current same-chat weighted few-shot behavior
reconstruct unread, merged, replied and reply-time state
preserve quote, mention, image and OCR semantics
block action tools and real-time lookup tools
use an isolated C0 copy with fixed model parameters, concurrency, timeout, retry and cache policy
known_legacy_replay_differences: bypasses GlobalStore merge, unread and replied lifecycle
changes memory, Wiki and search_memory behavior
does not reproduce WeFlow and OCR merge or deduplication
does not preserve quote, mention, image and OCR semantics
can introduce historical leakage through current-time tools or current Wiki

single_step_replay_review.cutoff: before sending, tool execution, replied-state updates, pending-memory updates or chat switching
single_step_replay_review.eligible_subset: entered ReplyGenerator, exact model call captured, and executed no tools
captured_evidence: runtime flags, model endpoint identity without credentials, and tool schemas
complete model arguments, prompts, responses and tool-call parameters
few-shot content, loaded skills and SessionMemory before and after generation
pre-action reply decision and eligibility reason

synthetic_preview.label: synthetic test only; not a production result
context: 乙：我先看看闹钟同不同意

remaining_differences: archive mode is opt-in instrumentation and still adds small capture overhead
single-step replay intentionally stops before production side effects and cannot evaluate later conversational state
tool-use and participation decisions are excluded from this first safe subset and require separate evaluation sets
no fresh production archive exists yet, so repeatability and evaluation reliability remain unproven
